title: Kestial
description: A slurry of mods I thought looked entertaining, definitely a work in progress
body: This is a fabric modpack that is still in development. I mainly made it with mods I found to be entertaining. This modpack is mainly convenience and decoration, such as more axolotl variants and easier netherite. Yet, it includes some more game altering mods, such as laser swords, better end, better nether, deeper and darker, and more! I hope anyone who plays this has a fun time with friends.
